Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the walk-through last week. As part of our legal and privacy onboarding checklist we need to collect a set of artifacts to close our DPIA and Art. 28/30 review. Can you provide the following?

- A current subprocessor inventory that shows country of processing and contractual flow (ideally CSV/Excel).
- An extract of your Article 30 processing ledger showing the Greenway scoping lines (sample will do).
- A short diagram or statement on key management (who holds keys, KMS provider, region).
- Any statements about transfers: SCCs, onshore hosting options, or safeguards you rely on.

We'd like to bundle these into our procurement packet by end of week. If there are limits on what you can share (redactions, sensitivity), flag them up and we can handle accordingly.

Best,
Amelia

4) Transfers: short write-up below and I can follow up with legal on SCC reliance.

Amelia — if acceptable, we can put the full package into the Drive folder (linked) and share via a secured link to your procurement/legal team. If Greenway needs a DocuSign or evidence portal entry instead, let us know.

Thanks,
